One row per format and nn.Linear; 72 KB in the rehearsal; tokens.csv (twin forward): How far does the output drift? One row per format, slice; 3 KB in the rehearsal; kl.csv (llama.cpp KL): What do llama.cpp users get? One row per slice, format; 3 KB in the rehearsal; summary.json (last): Can the run be reproduced? One row per run; 2 KB in the rehearsal
